description: Public calibration fixture measured by the same geometry preflight used for owned uploads. No supplier price, order, or printability certification is implied.

limitations: This report does not certify printability, dimensional accuracy, strength, safety, or suitability for an application.
No self-intersection, wall-thickness, support, clearance, material, printer, or manufacturing-tolerance analysis is performed.
STL vertices are matched exactly; cracks are not welded and coordinates are never repaired or rescaled automatically.
Stored STL facet normals are checked for finite values but vertex winding determines orientation and volume.
